title: Credit for Formulary Alternatives Tried, Formulary Benefit Non-Formulary Approvals
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a trial credit is added to a standard non-formulary exception approval for the formulary alternatives the member has tried. The trials are read from the member's paid retail claims under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.

**Alternatives tried.** These are the formulary alternatives in the drug's therapeutic class whose paid retail fills within the trial lookback of **6** months add up to at least the formulary's minimum trial days supply. A fill is within the lookback when its date of service lies fewer whole months than 6 before the decision date. For an acute-migraine drug the alternatives are sumatriptan and Nurtec ODT.

| Alternatives tried, compared with the formulary's required number of alternatives | Credit added |
|---|---|
| more than the required number | **3** months |
| equal to the required number | **1** month |
| fewer | nothing |

**Formulary figures used (by formulary):**

| Figure | Exclusive | Value | Standard | Preferred Drug List | Broad | Open |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum trial days supply | 30 | 30 | 30 | 28 | 28 | 28 |
| Required number of alternatives | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

The columns are the Northbridge Exclusive Formulary, Northbridge Value Formulary, Northbridge Standard Formulary, Northbridge Preferred Drug List, Northbridge Broad Formulary and Northbridge Open Formulary.

The credit is added to the approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

## Worked cases (hypothetical paid retail fills within the last 6 months)

| Formulary | Sumatriptan days | Nurtec ODT days | Alternatives tried | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Standard Formulary | 30 | 30 | 2, more than 1 | 3 months |
| Northbridge Preferred Drug List | 28 | 10 | 1, equal to 1 | 1 month |
| Northbridge Value Formulary | 30 | 28 | 1 (28 is below 30), fewer than 2 | nothing |
| Northbridge Exclusive Formulary | 45 | 30 | 2, equal to 2 | 1 month |
